Question: In the UNESCO UIS SDG 4 Education Indicators table for the indicator 'Completion rate, upper secondary education, both sexes (modelled data) (%)', what value is listed for Democratic Republic of the Congo (COD) in 2023?

A. 23.42000007629395%
B. 25.51000022888184%

Source citation: UNESCO UIS SDG 4 Education Indicators: Completion rate, upper secondary education, both sexes (modelled data) (%) (https://data.unesco.org/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/uis001/records?where=indicator_id+%3D+%22CR.MOD.3%22+and+year+%3D+date%272023-01-01%27&order_by=country_id&limit=100&offset=0)

output_text:
answer: A

reason: Based on the UNESCO UIS modelled data (indicator CR.MOD.3) for the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2023, the listed completion rate for upper secondary education, both sexes, is approximately 23.4%, which matches option A rather than the higher value in option B.
